title: Canonical etale finite quotient internal-Hom arrow
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite field extension and $X$ a scheme. Use the positive finite coefficient rings $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/(\varpi_E^n)$ of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and the ambient derived module categories on the small etale site. For $n\geq m\geq1$, let $F_{n,m}$ be derived scalar extension along the actual quotient $A_{E,n}\to A_{E,m}$ of [lem-pur-derived-change-of-rings]. With the published derived internal Hom $H_n$ and the canonical tensor comparison $\mu:F_{n,m}(T\otimes^L K)\cong F_{n,m}T\otimes^L F_{n,m}K$, define $v^{n,m}_{K,M}:F_{n,m}H_n(K,M)\to H_m(F_{n,m}K,F_{n,m}M)$ to be the tensor-Hom transpose of $\mu^{-1}$ followed by $F_{n,m}(\mathrm{ev}_n)$. The closed adjunction uses the published Koszul symmetry to put the Hom object first. For $n\geq m\geq r\geq1$, use the canonical scalar associator $F_{m,r}\circ F_{n,m}\cong F_{n,r}$, whose restriction adjoint is the identity-on-sections quotient composition. The intrinsic pro-etale operations of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] are reused for the corresponding pro-etale arrow and associator, rather than replaced. The etale tensor representative data are the actual local sheafified pure tensors followed by signed-total summand inclusions, and the localization tensorator of the published derived-category localization, transported to this uniquely normalized closed tensor. The intrinsic localization functor is the standard one of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom].
